concerns_updated.extraction_notes: Worklist concern_text refers to 'Incremental value of multi-omics over standard clinical risk factors (Framingham, SCORE2) demonstrated with NRI/IDI'. No such reviewer comment exists in this peer review file. Reviewer #1's actual comments (1-1..1-7) cover: imbalanced data/overfitting, need for non-NN baselines (XGBoost/RF), data composition/leakage from multi-CVD individuals, model architecture details, Figure 3 x-axis ranges, redundant text, figure adjustments. Reviewer #2's comments (2-1..2-11) cover: external validation, NTproBNP confounding, lipid metabolites, CVDeath GWAS, cohort demographics testing, broken demo weblink, internal-vs-external validation, statin counts, and grammar fixes. Neither reviewer raised NRI/IDI vs Framingham/SCORE2. The paper does compare incremental performance via delta C-index in Figure 3, but this was not a reviewer-requested addition. Likely upstream hallucinated/synthetic concern.

Worklist concern_text refers to 'Cost-effectiveness of proteomics+metabolomics panel for CVD screening / practical deployment uncertainty'. No reviewer in this peer review file raised cost-effectiveness or deployment cost concerns. Searches of all reviewer comments (1-1..1-7, 2-1..2-11) and author rebuttal sections found no mention of 'cost', 'cost-effectiveness', or 'deployment cost'. Reviewer #2 did raise external validation and generalizability (2-1, 2-7) and a discussion of clinical applicability, but not cost. Likely upstream hallucinated/synthetic concern.
